description: This file is a shell script involved in the upgrade process for Buffalo devices running OpenWrt. It includes functions for preparing UBI (Unsorted Block Images) partitions on NAND flash memory, specifically handling the 'ubi' and 'rootfs_1' partitions, with logic related to firmware upgrade procedures and boot behavior.

methods.name: buffalo_upgrade_prepare_ubi
methods.description: Prepares the UBI partitions on NAND flash for upgrade, including locating UBI devices and removing volumes.
